source_snapshot.items: Check GPU is suitable for ROCm DCT
source_snapshot.procedure: Build ROCm and ROCm DCT/RDC from official sources and check whether DCT can control the AMD GPU.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES substitutes read-only `rocm-smi`, which proves enumeration but not DCT control.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires pinned DCT/RDC artifact and an owner-selected lowest-risk reversible control property with stable target, baseline/test value, readback, restore and recovery.

old_problem: The source never defines what DCT control action proves suitability, while DeepSeek replaces write-capable control with unrelated read-only SMI enumeration; choosing clocks, power, fan or another property could destabilize the GPU and requires different recovery.
disposition_reason: A package/version can be parameterized, but the missing control property is the core test command semantics and determines blast radius, expected result and recovery. No ED rule authorizes selecting a GPU setting. Read-only enumeration cannot satisfy the explicit control criterion, so project/vendor authority is required.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row211 all18 XLSX cells and history2815.
Preserved build/install plus genuine DCT control capability and rejected `rocm-smi` substitution.
Required a bounded reversible property with mandatory restore rather than guessing a privileged write. No build, control or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: ROCm DCT/RDC control suitability pending approved reversible control property
test_case.purpose: Establish that the approved ROCm DCT/RDC stack supports the target AMD GPU and can perform one explicitly authorized lowest-risk reversible control operation with verified readback and restoration.
required_package: Pinned signed ROCm and DCT/RDC source/package revisions, checksums and compatibility matrix
Authoritative single control property/action approved for this GPU/platform
Stable GPU UUID/BDF selector, baseline value, bounded test value, tolerance and dwell
Privilege/audit policy and independent readback method
Thermal/power/error aborts, mandatory restore and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not perform a control write until the property is approved. Then build/install the pinned ROCm DCT/RDC stack, prove support for the exact GPU identity, record the property baseline through an independent readback, apply only the approved bounded test value, verify DCT and independent readback, dwell for the approved interval, restore the exact baseline and verify final GPU health. `rocm-smi` enumeration alone is not control proof.
test_case.expected_result: The approved DCT/RDC stack recognizes the exact GPU, the selected low-impact control changes only the intended property within tolerance, and the original value is restored with no GPU, thermal, power, driver or platform fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an approved control property, stable target, before/write/readback/restore evidence and final health. Enumeration or package installation alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: No write-capable DCT action without explicit property/value and recovery approval.
Pin the target by UUID/BDF and ensure no workload depends on the property.
Enforce bounded value/dwell and independent telemetry.
Abort and restore on wrong target/value, XID/ECC, thermal/power or driver fault; no automatic retry or property escalation.
expected_evidence: Stable GPU identity and pre-control baseline
DCT command/output plus independent changed-state readback
Restore command/readback, audit log and final GPU/platform health
test_case.recovery: Immediately restore the recorded baseline using the approved path on any anomaly; if restore fails, stop further writes, preserve audit/telemetry and use the pre-approved OOB driver/service recovery. Do not choose another property or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Source intent is coherent but underdefines the material control action; DeepSeek's SMI command is rejected as a non-source substitution.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution is prohibited until core control semantics and recovery are approved.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Approve one lowest-risk reversible DCT property, exact target/value/readback/restore and recovery plus pinned artifacts.
pending.owner: AMD ROCm/DCT, GPU platform and change-safety owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Provide an authoritative supported control operation with bounded expected state and verified restoration.

project_authority: Writable DCT properties, safe bounds and restoration are vendor/platform-specific and cannot be selected by AI.
